cases.name: etaf-ui-key-help-opens-in-place-and-restores-its-opener
cases.purpose: Read-only help stays in the original buffer/window, does not execute business commands and restores focus on Escape.

cases.name: etaf-ui-key-help-guards-local-commands-and-repeated-open
cases.purpose: Help blocks background letters and local command sequences, keeps native C-g and does not stack repeated openings.

cases.name: etaf-ui-key-help-keeps-its-snapshot-through-background-updates
cases.purpose: Background application updates preserve the captured help scope and appear after dismissal.

cases.name: etaf-ui-key-help-search-keeps-question-mark-as-text
cases.purpose: Search treats question marks as text, filters commands and uses layered Escape without dismissing two levels at once.

cases.name: etaf-ui-key-help-backdrop-click-ends-search-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: An outside pointer press closes help during native search, ends editing and restores focus without activating background commands.

cases.name: etaf-ui-modal-backdrop-click-dismisses-without-click-through
cases.purpose: Dialog and drawer backdrops dismiss only on pointer presses, keep inner actions open and restore the caller without click-through.

cases.name: etaf-ui-control-theme-defaults-and-explicit-overrides
cases.purpose: Shared control Theme tokens retain dark panel fallbacks, leave plain inputs unchanged, respect explicit Button props and preserve activation.

cases.name: etaf-ui-control-theme-keeps-editing-and-focus-geometry
cases.purpose: Palette changes preserve native editing and reserved focus geometry; unmount ends the input session.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-media-preserves-geometry-and-input
cases.purpose: Image cells and text fallback retain fixed metrics, focus, names and activation coordinates.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-rejects-invalid-media-props
cases.purpose: Invalid image callbacks, focus callbacks and cell heights are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-follows-replaced-projection-callbacks
cases.purpose: Replacing caller projections updates retained cell text, help and colors.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-preserves-cell-metrics-in-resized-containers
cases.purpose: Resized containers preserve intrinsic cell dimensions, text and activation coordinates.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-preserves-native-editing-state
cases.purpose: Enabling/configuring/disabling UI editing preserves multiline Unicode text, native keymaps, completion, point, selection, modification state and undo.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-placeholder-never-becomes-text
cases.purpose: An empty hint never becomes copied or submitted text; only text mutations notify and disabling detaches the observer.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-replacement-is-undoable-and-coalesced
cases.purpose: External replacements produce a final-value event and one undoable edit, while equal values preserve edit state silently.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-stale-update-preserves-edit-then-undo
cases.purpose: A delayed update cannot erase newer edits even when undo has restored the original text; a current tick permits replacement.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-copy-narrowing-and-read-only
cases.purpose: Exported text is detached and property-free across narrowing; read-only blocks typing while explicit updates remain possible.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-observer-failure-preserves-accepted-text
cases.purpose: Observer errors propagate without deleting accepted text; reentrant replacement is rejected without overwriting the edit.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-configuration-is-validated-before-change
cases.purpose: Invalid settings do not detach the installed observer, and invalid editor handles, text and ticks are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-instance-and-mode-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Independent editors do not share callbacks or content; changing major mode and killing a buffer retire their behavior.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-controls-coordinates-and-retains-neighbors
cases.purpose: Coordinate callbacks activate the correct tile; local color/text writes preserve neighboring Host identity and geometry.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-read-only-and-invalid-input
cases.purpose: Read-only grids expose no activation callbacks and reject invalid dimensions, callback types and overflowing labels before publication.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-registry-replaces-removes-and-validates
cases.purpose: Icon registrations round-trip and replace specifications, reject invalid replacements atomically, and remove their own name/glyph inventory.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-lookup-distinguishes-missing-name-and-set
cases.purpose: Partial maps resolve names through the requested/default style, preserve the provided inventory, show unknown names, and reject unknown styles; on a text display the terminal set answers an SVG request first while the requested style still owns names it lacks.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-svg-unavailable-has-printable-text-properties
cases.purpose: SVG-unavailable rendering preserves the terminal mark as printable text with native paint properties and the default minimum width on every row.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-text-mark-keeps-the-row-background
cases.purpose: A terminal icon paints ink only: the mark carries the requested foreground without inheriting the default face or a background, so marks of different widths keep one aligned column and a play mark does not cut a hole in its pill.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-terminal-set-resolves-marks-from-a-font-set
cases.purpose: A terminal can resolve an SVG request through a registered font set such as nerd and uses its glyph as text, so a terminal with an icon font gets the same marks as a graphical frame.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-renders-without-a-default-face-font
cases.purpose: An icon row keeps its one-line height contract when a graphical frame reports no resolved default face font instead of failing in font-info.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-box-keeps-two-rows-width-and-full-target
cases.purpose: Mounted icons occupy exactly two rows when requested, preserve minimum width and presentation props, and dispatch a callback from the whole Host.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-tab-index-keeps-a-pressable-icon-out-of-tab-order
cases.purpose: Pressable icons are Tab stops named by their label or help text, while a negative tab index keeps an icon clickable but skipped by Tab.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-inside-a-control-shows-the-control-help
cases.purpose: An icon without its own help text leaves the enclosing control's help visible over the icon.

cases.name: etaf-ui-toggle-icon-switches-glyph-and-paint-through-value
cases.purpose: A reactive toggle value switches the icon glyph and its paint in place while the box keeps its declared geometry, role and help text.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-metrics-estimates-fit-without-gui
cases.purpose: Batch-safe metrics distinguish fitting from oversized declarations without requiring installed fonts or a graphical frame.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-validates-box-and-supports-registered-draw
cases.purpose: Applications can add a draw-function SVG style entirely through registration; invalid sizing and callback props fail before rendering.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-registers-track-and-fill-hosts
cases.purpose: A mounted Range registers the Track and Fill Hosts that retained updates address.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-bar-height-changes-ink-without-changing-geometry
cases.purpose: Bar thickness changes graphical paint at a fixed one-row size while retaining value-driven widths; text-only frames keep a readable rule.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-fill-moves-through-retained-geometry
cases.purpose: A caller grows the Fill through ETAF's retained geometry update without publishing a new View.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-press-reports-change-and-commit
cases.purpose: A pointer click reports the pointed value through on-change and on-commit in that order.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-steps-from-the-keyboard
cases.purpose: Left/Right step a focused Range by its key step through on-commit, and Home/End report its bounds.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-without-ref-hit-tests-pointer-gestures
cases.purpose: A range mounted without a :ref still maps an engine pointer gesture to its value.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-drag-reports-live-values-and-commits-on-release
cases.purpose: Dragging reports intermediate values, commits the released value and ignores a cancelled gesture.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-snaps-to-the-step-and-clamps-the-ends
cases.purpose: Pointer values snap to :step and never escape :min..:max.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-disabled-rejects-pointer-events
cases.purpose: A disabled Range dispatches no callback and rejects pointer events.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-reactive-bound-reproportions-in-place
cases.purpose: A reactive :max bound re-proportions the Fill without a Component re-render.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-validates-its-input
cases.purpose: Invalid numeric props fail before the Range paints.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-resize-keeps-chrome-and-input
cases.purpose: Controlled catalog window sizes keep the title, eight handles and button targets, commit once per batch and match a fresh mount.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-resize-example-uses-controlled-handles
cases.purpose: The public catalog resize example updates controlled geometry and restores the original rectangle on cancellation.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-keeps-geometry-and-mode-controlled
cases.purpose: Window geometry remains caller-owned while controlled mode changes only the projected content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-forwards-chrome-and-resize-gestures
cases.purpose: Title-bar and resize-handle gestures reach caller callbacks with their edge and phase payloads.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-moves-and-resizes-from-keys-inside-it
cases.purpose: Focus entering a Window runs its on-focus; with focus inside, M-arrows reach its move callback and M-S-arrows its right/bottom resize callbacks as keyboard gestures.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-confirms-every-edge-and-corner
cases.purpose: All eight Window and standalone Panel handles accept locked resize at the confirming press and ignore subsequent motion and release positions.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-cancels-and-releases-active-targets
cases.purpose: Escape cancels each locked resize handle once, clears active state and preserves the following command.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-nil-keeps-ordinary-release
cases.purpose: Explicit nil and the standalone Panel default keep resize gestures ending at the first release.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-rejects-invalid-modifier
cases.purpose: Invalid lock modifiers are rejected through the public Component validation contract.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resizable-panel-rejects-unknown-edge
cases.purpose: Resizable panels reject unsupported edge names at the public Component boundary.

cases.name: etaf-ui-label-supports-box-geometry-and-text-presentation
cases.purpose: Label width, padding, border, wrapping and inherited text presentation match direct Ebox composition.

cases.name: etaf-ui-label-reflows-reactive-text-and-preserves-following-content
cases.purpose: Reactive English and Chinese text reflow inside the allocated width, preserving the Label ref and following content after resize.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-callback-uses-only-committed-props
cases.purpose: A later sibling failure cannot replace the live Button callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-columns-require-unique-non-nil-keys
cases.purpose: Reject ambiguous column identity with its index and offending key.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-stateless-table-keeps-pure-render-support
cases.purpose: Automatic row references do not introduce setup state into plain Tables.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-factory-rejects-ref-and-watch-creation
cases.purpose: A factory cannot allocate persistent state or subscriptions during render.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-row-and-column-reorder-retain-state
cases.purpose: Counter state follows row and column keys, with one cleanup on deletion.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-grid-reorders-without-remounting-cells
cases.purpose: DataGrid uses the same retained custom cells while preserving row identity.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-duplicate-field-migration-retains-distinct-state
cases.purpose: Name and Uppercase read the same field but retain distinct column identities.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-later-factory-error-retains-committed-handler
cases.purpose: A failed later cell cannot replace an earlier cell's committed callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-grid-publishes-current-rows-and-selection
cases.purpose: Replacing a row with equal or changed contents updates cell output and callback identity, while focus and selection remain consistent under retained keys.

cases.name: etaf-ui-docs-readmes-mount-and-dispatch-in-fresh-emacs
cases.purpose: Both catalog READMEs use real names and complete mounted interactions.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-wraps-complete-controls-in-narrow-space
cases.purpose: A narrow allocation wraps whole controls without clipping page text.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-keeps-explicit-colors-and-semantic-defaults
cases.purpose: Explicit colors remain effective without replacing omitted variant defaults.

cases.name: etaf-ui-adaptive-columns-reject-invalid-fractional-weights
cases.purpose: Invalid fractional tracks identify the offending column before mounting.

cases.name: etaf-ui-adaptive-cells-retain-identity-and-failed-candidates
cases.purpose: Adaptive row/column reorders preserve local state and rollback ownership.

cases.name: etaf-ui-table-string-column-keys-read-equal-alist-keys
cases.purpose: Table and DataGrid read string keys in both fixed and adaptive cells.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-use-behavior-dispatches-through-host
cases.purpose: Install Button `:use' Behavior and dispatch its merged callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-keeps-its-label-on-one-line
cases.purpose: A Button keeps its full label on one line when a narrow flex line would otherwise shrink it below its content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-hover-uses-the-variant-token
cases.purpose: A Button paints its variant's hover background from the catalog token.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-derives-hover-fill-from-a-custom-surface
cases.purpose: A Button with a custom surface derives a visibly different hover fill from that surface, while a surface-less Button still reads the variant token.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-focus-uses-a-visible-cue
cases.purpose: Keyboard focus underlines a Button label and fills a surface-less Button without changing geometry.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-input-validates-and-emits-value
cases.purpose: Prompt-backed number input owns bounds and emits the accepted value.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-input-stays-inline-in-a-wrapping-row
cases.purpose: A number input nested in another wrapping row keeps its steppers and value on one line.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-disabled-preserves-explicit-theme-surface
cases.purpose: A disabled Button keeps explicit dark presentation props in its surface.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-is-readable-and-boundary-safe
cases.purpose: Pagination renders labeled controls, stable refs, and page boundaries.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-composes-inside-a-grid-track
cases.purpose: Pagination must distribute free space inside its assigned Grid track.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-keeps-long-cells-on-one-line
cases.purpose: Long tabular values use an ellipsis instead of increasing row height.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-converts-character-columns-and-keeps-air
cases.purpose: Character column descriptors become pixel widths with a stable gap.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-rejects-nil-row-ref
cases.purpose: Reject an interactive row-ref callback that returns nil.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-projects-loading-error-and-empty
cases.purpose: Project the Data Controller loading, error, and empty states.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-requires-stable-row-key
cases.purpose: Reject a DataGrid that cannot identify retained rows.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-rejects-nil-row-key
cases.purpose: Reject a DataGrid row-key function that returns no identity.

cases.name: etaf-ui-checkbox-binding-shares-the-callers-ref
cases.purpose: Bound and explicit checkboxes observe one ref with additive events, disabled protection and unmount cleanup.

cases.name: etaf-ui-binding-retargets-only-after-successful-publication
cases.purpose: Binding target changes publish atomically; conflicts preserve committed callbacks and explicit nil remains valid.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-binding-validates-cancel-and-disabled-input
cases.purpose: A bound number input writes accepted integers and preserves its ref after cancellation, invalid or disabled input.

cases.name: etaf-ui-bindings-report-conflicting-or-read-only-inputs
cases.purpose: Conflicts and invalid binding targets report contextual component input errors.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-controls-render-async-refresh-and-cancellation
cases.purpose: Pending reads/writes, cancellation and failure retain accepted rows and actions with valid focus.

cases.name: etaf-ui-select-maps-labels-to-controlled-values
cases.purpose: Selection preserves nil values, handles cancellation and disables empty lists.

cases.name: etaf-ui-native-inputs-report-invalid-props-in-context
cases.purpose: Invalid values, options and bindings identify the Component and property.

cases.name: etaf-ui-menu-selects-enabled-actions-and-returns-focus
cases.purpose: Menu choices follow published props; disabled actions are unavailable and cancellation preserves data and focus.

cases.name: etaf-ui-confirm-dialog-composes-with-menu-actions
cases.purpose: Menu actions apply only after native confirmation and return focus after a declined dialog.

cases.name: etaf-ui-control-forwards-native-feedback
cases.purpose: Native root attributes reach Ebox through the public Button component.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-hover-keeps-text-readable
cases.purpose: A Theme without hover tokens derives a distinct fill per palette that keeps at least the label's resting contrast, or 4.5:1 on an extreme surface.

cases.name: etaf-ui-grid-and-table-share-row-presentation
cases.purpose: Table and DataGrid produce matching layout and selection paint while all row fields remain business data.

cases.name: etaf-ui-grid-rows-use-framework-identity-and-callbacks
cases.purpose: Separate grids retain unique automatic targets across reorder and publish current row data and handlers through the framework.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-input-validates-configuration-and-live-value
cases.purpose: NumberInput validates configuration before publishing inputs and follows caller-owned integer values through native editing.

cases.name: etaf-ui-reactions-toggle-chips-and-pick-choices
cases.purpose: Reaction chips report their key, keep their footprint when chosen, and the picker popover adds a chosen reaction then closes; malformed and compound keys are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dropdown-opens-navigates-selects-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: A dropdown renders its items, skips disabled ones and invokes selection once.

cases.name: etaf-ui-menu-hover-token-resolves-against-the-provided-theme
cases.purpose: A dropdown row's hover tint resolves the provided theme token into a concrete colour.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-composes-slots-and-blocks-covered-controls
cases.purpose: The modal canvas covers background targets and returns focus after closing.

cases.name: etaf-ui-modal-backdrop-dims-and-restores-the-painted-application
cases.purpose: A modal keeps the application painted and dims it, then restores its original paint on close.

cases.name: etaf-ui-media-viewer-owns-keys-browses-and-closes
cases.purpose: An open media viewer covers the application, outranks its emulation keys, browses with n/p and the arrows, swallows other printing keys, closes with q or Escape and returns focus.

cases.name: etaf-ui-media-viewer-closes-on-backdrop-and-close-control
cases.purpose: A click on the media viewer's backdrop or its close control requests closing; a key on the backdrop does not.

cases.name: etaf-ui-media-viewer-shows-audio-with-a-transport
cases.purpose: An audio viewer shows the speaker stage, its total time and the caption.

cases.name: etaf-ui-media-viewer-supports-audio-volume-and-playback-keys
cases.purpose: MediaViewer accepts :audio, :volume and :on-ended props and binds j/l for 10-second seeks and [/] for volume adjustments.

cases.name: etaf-ui-media-viewer-hides-the-mounted-buffer-cursor
cases.purpose: A media viewer opened from another current buffer hides the mounted buffer's cursor and restores it on close.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dismisses-surfaces-on-presses-outside-their-panel
cases.purpose: A root press capture calling etaf-ui-dismiss-outside-press closes open surfaces the press missed, keeps the pressed panel open and leaves a surface opened by the same press mounted.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-compact-height-keeps-one-row-header
cases.purpose: A bounded compact dialog keeps its title to one row while preserving background content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-floating-surfaces-nest-and-release-buffer-shortcuts
cases.purpose: Escape closes a menu nested in a dialog, then the dialog; outer Host keys are ignored while a surface is open and return after it closes.

cases.name: etaf-ui-popover-keeps-instance-state-and-independent-open-inputs
cases.purpose: Two controlled popovers have independent state and clean up their slots.

cases.name: etaf-ui-nested-dialog-covers-parent-and-restores-its-controls
cases.purpose: A nested modal blocks the outer panel and restores it on close.

cases.name: etaf-ui-unpainted-popover-does-not-capture-keys
cases.purpose: An unavailable anchor leaves the mounted buffer's ordinary keys usable.

cases.name: etaf-ui-surfaces-example-composes-menu-dialog-and-input
cases.purpose: The runnable example hands menu focus to a dialog and back to its trigger.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-browses-every-component-family
cases.purpose: All eight categories expose every named component specimen.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-sidebar-selection-keeps-labels-stationary
cases.purpose: Every Gallery sidebar category highlights without shifting labels or changing typeface in light and dark Themes.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-overview-keeps-preview-content-whole
cases.purpose: Multi-row overview avatars finish before the card caption at wide and compact widths instead of being cropped.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-compact-picker-opens-component-families
cases.purpose: The compact category picker opens overlay and basic component specimens without a sidebar.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-preserves-state-across-browsing-and-theme
cases.purpose: Specimen state survives browsing and scoped Theme changes; reset restores defaults.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-copies-runnable-examples
cases.purpose: Every component displays a public signature and parameter reference; its copied example evaluates and mounts independently.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-isolates-mounts-and-unrelated-buffers
cases.purpose: Independent Galleries do not share state or overwrite unrelated buffer contents.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-searches-symbols-chinese-and-clears-empty-results
cases.purpose: Native live search matches symbols and Chinese across categories and recovers from no matches.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-reference-explains-value-and-callback-contracts
cases.purpose: Scrolled reference text exposes defaults, controlled-value exclusions, callback payloads and units; reset collapses it.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-dialog-submits-chinese-and-cancels
cases.purpose: A modal submits Chinese text, cancels without changing saved values, and restores opener focus.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-paginates-and-reopens-after-unmount
cases.purpose: Local paging and reset publish the expected records; reopening releases old state and preserves other applications.

cases.name: etaf-ui-feedback-and-navigation-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Feedback and navigation Components render and dispatch through public refs.

cases.name: etaf-ui-disclosures-use-arrows-and-stable-control-names
cases.purpose: Menus, selectors, accordion and tree disclosures show arrow cues and preserve control names across expansion.

cases.name: etaf-ui-selection-keeps-label-positions-sizes-and-typeface
cases.purpose: Tabs, segments, steps and Select chips keep label positions, control sizes and font weights unchanged across selection.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tabs-keep-every-label-in-place-when-switching
cases.purpose: Switching the active tab keeps every tab label in the same column, so the strip never shifts.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tabs-address-items-by-ref
cases.purpose: An item's optional :ref lets a caller press its tab control by name.

cases.name: etaf-ui-calendar-aligns-weekdays-dates-and-selection
cases.purpose: Calendar dates and leading blanks align with the same seven weekday columns and stay aligned as selection changes.

cases.name: etaf-ui-slider-arrows-stay-on-aligned-values
cases.purpose: Mounted bound sliders keep arrow results and displayed values aligned at non-step maxima, negative bounds, narrow spans and equal bounds.

cases.name: etaf-ui-selection-components-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Radio, Segmented, Switch and Slider render controlled values through the public DSL.

cases.name: etaf-ui-drawer-composes-both-sides-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: Both modal drawer edges retain caller-owned values, compose footer actions, dismiss and restore the opener.

cases.name: etaf-ui-composition-components-reject-invalid-props
cases.purpose: Malformed shortcut keys, duplicate list identities and absent current steps are rejected through public component inputs.

cases.name: etaf-ui-advanced-components-compose-public-contracts
cases.purpose: DatePicker, Tree, Calendar and CommandPalette compose shared public input, navigation and floating-surface contracts.

cases.name: etaf-ui-qr-paint-draws-modules-with-scannable-contrast
cases.purpose: Painted sign-in code pairs module rows, honours the quiet zone and keeps black-on-white glyphs; malformed rows are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-ui-qr-login-overlays-the-code-and-returns-its-dismissal
cases.purpose: The sign-in panel follows caller-owned visibility, code and status, blocks the covered page, and reports close from Escape and its cancel button.

cases.name: etaf-ui-qr-login-renders-square-svg-fitting-compact-graphical-viewport

cases.name: etaf-ui-composition-components-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Tag, Kbd, Steps and List compose through public props and caller-owned selection callbacks.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-reactive-geometry-preserves-content-and-input

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-publishes-other-changes-during-editing
cases.purpose: Application state changes publish while a field is being edited.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-disabled-and-read-only-are-not-editable
cases.purpose: Disabled and read-only fields open no editing session.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-installs-completion-and-keymap
cases.purpose: Completion functions complete the value and field key bindings run during the session only.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-leaving-keeps-the-draft
cases.purpose: Pressing the field keeps editing; pressing another Host or unmounting leaves with the typed draft kept.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-relayouts-while-editing
cases.purpose: A viewport refit applies immediately while editing continues.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-focus-recolours-a-reserved-frame
cases.purpose: Focus recolours the outlined frame without moving layout; the plain variant has no frame.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-shows-a-caret-and-restores-state
cases.purpose: Editing shows a bar caret and ending restores the buffer cursor.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-validates-props-and-ends-once
cases.purpose: Invalid props are reported in component context and ending a session twice releases it once.

cases.name: etaf-ui-search-field-edits-clears-and-keeps-editing
cases.purpose: A search field edits its query live; its clear control empties the query, reports the clear and keeps editing.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pane-resizer-reports-clamped-widths
cases.purpose: Dragging a pane resizer reports widths clamped to its bounds and the final width on release; the focused divider steps the width with Left/Right.

cases.name: etaf-ui-composites-are-one-tab-stop-entered-at-the-selection
cases.purpose: Tabs form one Tab stop entered at the active tab; arrows and C-b move between tabs without selecting them.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tree-branches-open-right-and-close-left
cases.purpose: A focused Tree branch expands with Right and collapses with Left through the caller's on-toggle.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-grid-updates-rows-with-stable-extents
cases.purpose: Independent Unicode rows update in place with exact padded widths, stable neighbors and no focus targets.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-grid-rejects-invalid-shapes-and-text
cases.purpose: Invalid dimensions, heights, callbacks, multiline, tabbed and overflowing text fail through the public component interface.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-grid-scrolls-a-million-rows-through-its-viewport
cases.purpose: A million-row grid with a height shows its viewport, follows scroll calls and keys, reports the first visible row, repaints rows that read a changed ref and builds only rows near the viewport.

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-grid-keeps-its-viewport-within-changing-rows
cases.purpose: Shrinking the row count below a scrolled grid clamps its viewport to the last rows, and a grown grid scrolls into the new rows.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-body-reads-the-content-region
cases.purpose: Window body content reads the window's content box as its viewport.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-full-bleed-body-reaches-the-frame-edges
cases.purpose: A full-bleed window gives its body the rows of its edge handles.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-full-bleed-handles-own-edge-input
cases.purpose: All eight resize handles own their painted cells and directional pointers across full-bleed geometry changes; child controls retain their authored pointer.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-full-bleed-handles-leave-the-body-painted
cases.purpose: A full-bleed resize strip keeps its pointer target while the body's own background stays painted across the window edge cells.

cases.name: etaf-ui-svg-elements-emit-compact-escaped-markup
cases.purpose: Scene helpers format numbers compactly, keep attribute order and escape XML values.

cases.name: etaf-ui-svg-elements-reject-invalid-geometry-and-attributes
cases.purpose: Invalid geometry, attribute keys, repeated keys and values signal one readable condition.

cases.name: etaf-ui-svg-image-builds-valid-documents
cases.purpose: The image descriptor wraps a well-formed desktop-sized SVG document with viewbox and aspect ratio.

cases.name: etaf-ui-svg-image-feeds-a-retained-image-host
cases.purpose: A composed scene keeps fixed cell metrics, accessibility names, focus and activation.

cases.name: etaf-ui-edge-panel-keeps-its-title-on-the-rule
cases.purpose: 面板把标题、状态和正文依次画出，标题写在顶边那一行。

cases.name: etaf-ui-edge-tabs-dispatch-the-pressed-tab
cases.purpose: 顶边标签页画出所有标签，按下一个标签时把它的 key 交给回调。

cases.name: etaf-ui-underline-field-shows-placeholder-until-it-has-a-value
cases.purpose: 下划线字段在值为空时画出占位文字，有值时画值本身。

cases.name: etaf-ui-theme-tokens-maps-palette-roles
cases.purpose: Each supplied application palette role becomes every catalog color token that names it.

cases.name: etaf-ui-theme-tokens-derives-omitted-roles
cases.purpose: Omitted palette roles derive from the surface, the text and whether the background is light or dark.

cases.name: etaf-ui-theme-tokens-rejects-invalid-palettes
cases.purpose: A palette without both base colors, with an unknown role or with a non-string color signals wrong-type-argument.

cases.name: etaf-ui-color-legible-keeps-a-syntax-colour-on-its-page
cases.purpose: A colour below the WCAG AA ratio on its surface is mixed toward black or white until it passes, keeping its hue, and a colour that already passes is unchanged.

cases.name: etaf-ui-color-contrast-measures-the-wcag-ratio
cases.purpose: Contrast is 1 for one colour twice, about 21 for black on white, and 0 for a colour with no channels.

cases.name: etaf-ui-theme-tokens-paint-catalog-components
cases.purpose: Provided palette tokens paint a mounted catalog control, and a token placed before the result overrides it.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-line-fits-aligns-and-separates-cells
cases.purpose: Cells keep their declared width, align their text, truncate overflow and end in a separator.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-line-paints-ebox-stripes-and-the-row-rule
cases.purpose: Separators are one-pixel spaces or box-rule glyphs with per-cell colours, and the row rule spans the line.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-line-rejects-cells-it-cannot-paint
cases.purpose: Broken widths, non-string or multi-line text and unknown alignment fail instead of painting.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-builds-only-the-viewport
cases.purpose: A 100000-row sheet paints only its viewport, and revealing a far cursor scrolls to it.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-paints-cursor-and-selection
cases.purpose: The cursor cell keeps its outline, selected cells take the selection fill, unselected ones do not.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-repaints-when-the-caller-bumps-version
cases.purpose: Cell text changes reach the sheet only after the caller bumps the version ref.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-adds-lines-for-a-tall-row
cases.purpose: A row declared taller paints filler lines that keep the row rule and push later rows down.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-edits-a-cell-through-the-field
cases.purpose: Editing promotes the cell into a text field showing its raw value and reports the submitted text.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-rejects-invalid-props
cases.purpose: Invalid sizes, widths, callbacks, cursor and header declarations signal before publication.

cases.name: etaf-ui-sheet-pages-the-viewport-without-moving-the-cursor
cases.purpose: etaf-sheet-scroll pages by lines, shows later rows, and leaves the caller's cursor untouched.

cases.name: etaf-ui-keycap-and-check-mark-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Action and region keycaps keep their two levels, draw their captions and dispatch presses, while a disabled cap keeps its slot; the check mark spells each state on a text frame and rejects an unknown state.

cases.name: etaf-ui-list-draws-checkbox-selection-and-meta
cases.purpose: A list draws its checkbox column, its trailing meta and its selected row, and reports a press through the caller's callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-metrics-slice-icons-at-the-canvas-row
cases.purpose: A two-row icon is cut at the line height the canvas draws, so a canvas font or text scale does not leave the picture a row short of the cells that hold it.

cases.name: etaf-ui-spinner-cycles-frames-and-validates-props
cases.purpose: Spinner cycles fixed-width frames on the shared clock, stops on unmount and rejects invalid props.

cases.name: etaf-ui-animated-feedback-progress-statistic-and-skeleton
cases.purpose: Opt-in animated progress, statistic and skeleton components advance smoothly on the shared clock.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-animated-backdrop-fades-in
cases.purpose: An animated dialog dims its backdrop over time on open and dismisses cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-ui-svg-stage-composites-only-overlapping-tiles-and-falls-back
cases.purpose: SVG stage composites sprites onto overlapped tiles, dispatches tile activation and falls back to cell text when non-graphic.

cases.name: etaf-ui-accordion-compact-borders-visible-hover-and-empty-body
cases.purpose: Accordion headers stay compact with primary ink, preserve border overline/underline under visible theme-derived hover in dark and light palettes, and omit hollow body boxes for empty content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-projects-into-modal-host-with-dimmed-backdrop
cases.purpose: Centered modal dialogs delegate card rendering to `etaf-ui-modal-host-function' on graphical displays when `etaf-ui-modal-use-child-frame' is enabled, keeping the uniformly dimmed backdrop scrim in the parent buffer.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-defaults-to-centered-in-buffer-with-uniform-backdrop
cases.purpose: Centered modal dialogs default to in-buffer rendering with exact vertical centering, uniform dimmed canvas background and clean focus restoration.

cases.name: etaf-ui-host-theme-wcag-and-oklch-calming
cases.purpose: Host-adaptive theme palettes enforce WCAG AA legibility on base and raised surfaces and calm neon dark-mode accents in OKLCH space.

cases.name: etaf-ui-host-theme-curated-seeds-and-css-vars
cases.purpose: Curated seeds stay exact while omitted tiers derive coherently, project onto catalog Theme tokens and resolve via ECSS `--etaf-*' custom properties.

cases.name: etaf-ui-host-theme-ref-reacts-to-mode-and-theme-switch
cases.purpose: Reactive host theme refs update on mode-ref writes and reject malformed options and transforms cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-ui-virtual-list-fixed-height-renders-o-viewport-and-scrolls
cases.purpose: Fixed-height 5,000-row virtual list mounts only O(viewport + 2*overscan) rows and renders target slices across mid and end jumps.

cases.name: etaf-ui-virtual-list-dynamic-heights-and-scroll-anchor
cases.purpose: Dynamic-height virtual list measures multi-line row heights post-commit and anchors scroll offsets when rows above the viewport grow.

cases.name: etaf-ui-virtual-list-keyboard-navigation-and-empty-state
cases.purpose: Virtual list handles arrow, page, home, end and RET navigation without unnecessary scroll jumps and shows empty states cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-ui-virtual-list-5000-rows-constant-order-benchmark
cases.purpose: Verify 5,000-row virtual list matches 500-row O(viewport) initial render count and completes repeated scroll jumps in constant-order time.
